entities.summary: Bolivarian Republic, a political institution in Venezuela during Chávez and the Bolivarian Revolution (1999–2006). Grew from New Bolivarian Constitution approved — December 1999. Led to the emergence of Failed coup against Chávez — April 11–13, 2002 and PDVSA oil strike — December 2002–February 2003.
